# Synth-JDoc source

`synth_jdoc_generator.py` is an unmodified copy of
https://github.com/llm-jp/synth-jdoc/blob/06d27a594b5680e73f3b1308a5ff86261365903d/src/synth/img_generator.py

Upstream: llm-jp/Synth-JDoc, revision `06d27a594b5680e73f3b1308a5ff86261365903d`.
License: Apache-2.0; see `SYNTH_JDOC_LICENSE` (copied from the same revision).
Our adapter imports the HTML template, layout configuration and vertical-text formatting.
It does not run the upstream data preparation or image generation services.
